title: Ratcopter - Alpha
author: Doromino
selftext:
Hi all,

I am a former game designer/developer for Xbox, Wii, Facebook, and Mobile games.  With the help of AI, I can finally reignite my passion with games while working full time as a software developer for a non-gaming company (mostly for a stable living and less crunch time).

  
I just made some major update for my flappy bird clone. It's a duel against the AI. Come check it out!.

[https://azurestudio808.itch.io/ratcopter](https://azurestudio808.itch.io/ratcopter)

AI Development Details and thoughts:  
Initially, I created this game by hand using Solar2D for mobile and I looked up how to code a flappy bird game. It was an old project experiment that got revived in the light of agentic AI.  I wanted to see what happens when the flappy bird wobbles while you play... adding more difficulty to an already difficult game.

I am very bad at drawing art, so I used AI to generate most of my art for me using my own local computer with 8GB VRAM on a RTX 4070 and stable diffusion.  It only takes about 30 seconds per art piece and it could get faster I had used sprite sheets.

Now majority of the code base was refactored to work on the web with LUA script.

I used AI to help me generate AI enemy patterns, the style of each characters, and the world map building copying the concepts from a Street Fighter 2 style game. 

The AI opponent idea came from my old background on working in Tetris Battle on Facebook.

There are plenty more rooms for improvements.  Let me know what you think.  

Thank you,

Azure
